skills.short: Install the One CLI agent skill
skills.install.short: Install or refresh the bundled one-cli skill for selected agents
skills.install.long:
Installs only the bundled one-cli skill into each selected agent's user skills directory. Works offline and outside a workspace. Repeating the command replaces the one-cli directory, including old references; other skills and legacy symlink stores remain untouched.

With --agent, install to those agents directly. Otherwise select detected agents interactively (all preselected). With --yes or without a terminal, use all detected agents. If no agents are detected, specify --agent explicitly. CODEX_HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, XDG_CONFIG_HOME and VIBE_HOME are honored when set to absolute directories.

After installation, load the skill from the reported directory; restart your agent session if it does not discover new skills automatically.
skills.flag.yes: Install to all detected agents without prompting
skills.select: Select agents to install the one-cli skill for
root.help:
one — workspace development

USAGE
  one <command> [options]

EVERYDAY COMMANDS
  create        Create a workspace
  add           Add a project
  dev           Start local development
  build         Build projects
  env           Manage environment variables
  login         Sign in to Infisical in your browser

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output  Output format: json | yaml | text
  -h, --help    Show help
  -v, --version Show version

EXAMPLES
  one create demo
  one add
  one dev
  one build

All commands: one help --all
Command help: one <command> --help
help.all_intro: All commands remain available. Everyday work usually needs only create, add, dev, build, env, and login.

locale.tip:
Shows the saved language preference and the language active in this terminal. Pass auto, zh-CN, or en-US to change the preference.

auto follows LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, then LANG; the fallback is English. The Dashboard shares this preference. Project and third-party tool logs keep their original language.
run.tip:
Loads project environment variables and runs a command in the project directory. Select a project by name or relative path, or run from inside a project. The positional project and --project must agree when both are used.

Use -- to separate One options from the child command. --env overrides the workspace default environment; --env-provider selects dotenv or Infisical. Loaded values override existing shell environment variables.

With --global, provide --env and --path explicitly. The command keeps the current working directory. Use --keys to select which shared credentials to inject.
serve.tip:
Starts a local settings page for workspaces, project configuration, Infisical login, and shared credentials. Review manifest changes before saving. Variable lists show names and descriptions; plaintext is fetched only when viewed or copied.

By default, binds to 127.0.0.1 on an available port and opens your browser. Press Ctrl-C to stop. Host and Origin checks protect the local interface.

task.ui.help:

Enter  Send keyboard input to project
Ctrl+]  Return to navigation
PgUp/PgDn  Scroll history
f  Follow latest output
h  Hide/show project list
/  Search projects
Esc  Clear search
Ctrl+C / q  Stop all tasks
